draft.subject: Photographing Boreal Quartet's July 12 performance at Metro Concert Hall.
draft.body: I'm writing about Boreal Quartet's July 12 performance at Metro Concert Hall. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage of live performance, working quietly enough that the audience doesn't notice me and nothing on stage gets disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for close to ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. I'd be glad to cover the July 12 date if you don't have someone on it already. Either way, it would be good to talk through your photography plans for the performance. I look forward to hearing from you.
